text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- It is not yet known whether the American initiative for the Cyprus problem will be announced, Russian ambassador says.
- U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan allays fears of a war in Cyprus; U.N. sees signs of a "cooling off".
- Turkey signs $543m helicopter deals with the French-German Group Eurocopter and the U.S. firm Sikorsky.
- Consumer price Index remains stable at 118,07 for January.
